source: Invented for this repository: a printed page in the layout of a baptism register, with invented names. It shows the format of a sample only; it is not handwriting and says nothing about reading quality.
transcription:
Anno 1830
Die 14. Martii baptizata est Anna, filia legitima Joannis Nowak coloni N. 15 et Catharinae uxoris eius.
Patrina Rosalia Swobodowa. Baptizavit Franciscus Kral cooperator.
